extra.stata_command: ddml init interactive|iv|interactiveiv, foldvar(fold1); learners regress / logit; ddml crossfit; ddml estimate, robust
extra.fold_source: user -- fold_id + 1 passed to ddml init foldvar(), the same partition DoubleML and sp.dml consume
extra.learners: regress for continuous conditional expectations, logit (unpenalised MLE) for binary ones; no stacking, no tuning
extra.pliv_intercept: ddml's PLIV second stage carries an intercept that DoubleML's score does not; this is the source of the 6.9e-7 PLIV gap
extra.stata_bridge_status: materialized 2026-08-06 with licensed Stata 18 and ddml from SSC
